structured_output.summary: The change implements Iterator.prototype.drop steps 1-14 in prototype_drop.rs in spec order. Argument validation (TypeError on non-object, ToNumber with IfAbruptCloseIterator, NaN / >2^53-1 / negative RangeErrors closed via iterator_close) matches the spec. GetIteratorDirect is called after validation and the closure skips `remaining` items with IteratorStep, then yields with IteratorStepValue. Errors from the skip and step loops propagate with `?` and do not close the iterator, as the spec requires. No special-cased inputs, no swallowed errors, no made-up values, and no unrelated edits. The only point I could not verify from the diff is that step 11.c.iv (close the underlying iterator when Yield is abruptly completed) relies on the default HelperClosure::on_return, which is not in this diff.

problems.question: skips_observable_steps
problems.issue: Spec step 11.c.iv (IfAbruptCloseIterator on Yield completion, which calls iterator return) is not implemented in this file. The code only leaves a comment pointing to HelperClosure::on_return. This is fine only if the default on_return in the shared helper calls IteratorClose(iterated, completion). That default is outside this diff and was not verified. The lint flag at line 74 is this same delegation and is a doc-comment placement issue, not a skipped computation.

structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: Verify that HelperClosure's default on_return (in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/support/iterator_helper.rs) performs IteratorClose(underlying[0], return completion) with the spec's semantics, so that return() on a suspended-at-yield drop helper closes the underlying iterator. If it does not, DropClosure needs an on_return override. Also move the step 11.a comment (`Let remaining be 𝔽(intLimit)`) from the struct field doc to code directly above the `remaining: int_limit` initialisation, per the convention that each step comment sits directly above its code.
